about: Known issues (SR-357), matched by symptom (a case-insensitive regular expression over what was seen), not by name. state: open or fixed; fixed: the date its fix reached main.

issues.title: judge line, no key or no judge configured
issues.symptom: (no judge can be reached|judging unavailable).*(no key|not configured|api key)
issues.cause: no judge configured or no key found; each step said so on its own

issues.title: judge line, timeout or HTTP error
issues.symptom: (no judge can be reached|judging unavailable).*(time ?out|timed out|http)
issues.cause: a judge answering with an HTTP error or a timeout held the turn

issues.title: judge line, answer out of schema or diff too large
issues.cause: one unusable judge answer left the whole job waiting

issues.title: judge line shown while the judge answered and set its questions aside
issues.symptom: (judge|it) answered.*(unreachable|no judge can be reached)|(unreachable|no judge can be reached).*(judge|it) answered|questions? (were |are )?set aside
issues.cause: questions the judge set aside are reported with the no-judge line (SR-359 fixes it)

issues.title: the judge asks again questions already answered
issues.cause: an old-way settings.json without the AskUserQuestion answer hook

issues.title: answers or edits not recorded after a mid-session plugin upgrade
issues.cause: the new version's private copy was not ready when the hooks ran

issues.title: behaviour fixed in main still shows (the cached plugin is never refreshed)
issues.cause: the cached plugin is never refreshed, its version stays 0.1.0 (SR-358 shows it)
